sn11.7:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave Sakkassa devānam indassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || || Yo pi me assa paccatthiko tassa pāham na dubbheyyan ti || || Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo Sakkassa devānam indassa cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya yena Sakko devānam indo ten-upasaṅkami || || Addasā kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vepacittim asurindaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || disvāna Vepacittim asurindam etad avoca || || Tiṭṭha Vepacitti gahito sī ti || ||
sn11.7:2.1: Yad eva te mārisa pubbe cittaṃ || tad eva tvam mā pahāsī ti ||
sn11.7:3.1: Sapassu ca me Vepacitti adubbhāyā ti || ||
sn11.7:4.1: Yam musābhaṇato pāpam || yam pāpam ariyūpavādino|| mittadduno ca yam pāpaṃ || yam pāpam akataññuno || tam eva pāpam phusati || yo te dubbhe Sujampatī ti || ||
